package sql_test

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/rqlite/sql"
)

type mutationRecorder struct {
	events []string
}

func (v *mutationRecorder) Visit(node sql.Node) (sql.Visitor, sql.Node, error) {
	v.events = append(v.events, "enter "+typeName(node))
	return v, node, nil
}

func (v *mutationRecorder) VisitEnd(node sql.Node) (sql.Node, error) {
	v.events = append(v.events, "leave "+typeName(node))
	return node, nil
}

func typeName(node sql.Node) string {
	switch node.(type) {
	case *sql.SelectStatement, *sql.UpdateStatement:
		return "statement"
	case *sql.QualifiedTableName:
		return "table"
	case *sql.BinaryExpr:
		return "where"
	default:
		return "other"
	}
}

type mutationStopVisitor struct {
	target   sql.Node
	sentinel error
}

func (v mutationStopVisitor) Visit(node sql.Node) (sql.Visitor, sql.Node, error) {
	if node == v.target {
		return nil, node, v.sentinel
	}
	return v, node, nil
}

func (v mutationStopVisitor) VisitEnd(node sql.Node) (sql.Node, error) {
	return node, nil
}

func TestWalkMutationProbe(t *testing.T) {
	assertOrder(t, "SELECT target.id FROM source WHERE target.id = source.id", 1)
	assertOrder(t, "UPDATE target SET value = source.value FROM source WHERE target.id = source.id", 2)

	shallow, err := sql.NewParser(strings.NewReader("UPDATE target SET value = 1 FROM shallow")).ParseStatement()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	target := shallow.(*sql.UpdateStatement).Source
	sentinel := errors.New("stop")
	_, err = sql.Walk(mutationStopVisitor{target: target, sentinel: sentinel}, shallow)
	if err != sentinel {
		t.Fatalf("error=%v, want %v", err, sentinel)
	}
}

func assertOrder(t *testing.T, query string, sourceTableIndex int) {
	t.Helper()
	stmt, err := sql.NewParser(strings.NewReader(query)).ParseStatement()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	recorder := &mutationRecorder{}
	if _, err := sql.Walk(recorder, stmt); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Walk returned error: %v", err)
	}
	var tableIndices []int
	for i, event := range recorder.events {
		if event == "enter table" {
			tableIndices = append(tableIndices, i)
		}
	}
	whereIndex := indexOf(recorder.events, "enter where")
	if len(tableIndices) <= sourceTableIndex || whereIndex < 0 || tableIndices[sourceTableIndex] > whereIndex {
		t.Fatalf("%s: source must be visited before where: %v", query, recorder.events)
	}
}

func indexOf(values []string, wanted string) int {
	for i, value := range values {
		if value == wanted {
			return i
		}
	}
	return -1
}
